# Riviera Journeys

> Riviera Journeys is an editorial bureau on the Côte d'Azur, based in Cannes, France, arranging private day tours, shore excursions, multi-day journeys and airport transfers along the French and Italian Riviera. The vehicle is a Mercedes V-Class, up to seven passengers. The site doubles as a journal — every photograph is taken in the field by the bureau.

## Identity

Riviera Journeys is **not** Riviera Travel (the UK river-cruise operator). The two are unrelated: Riviera Journeys is a single-vehicle private transport bureau on the French Riviera; Riviera Travel is a large escorted-tours and river-cruise company headquartered in Burton-on-Trent, England.

- **Trading name:** Riviera Journeys (since 2024; previously Fine Journeys, 2021–2024)
- **Legal form:** Entrepreneur individuel, France (sole proprietorship)
- **Registered as:** Andrey Bondarenko, SIREN 828 952 432
- **APE / NAF:** 4932Z — Transports de voyageurs par taxis
- **Registered seat:** 8 Chemin du Clos d'Entoures, 06530 Spéracèdes, France
- **Operating area:** Cannes, Nice, Monaco, Antibes, Saint-Tropez, Villefranche, Menton, Eze, Grasse, and the Italian Riviera as far as Sanremo and Cinque Terre
- **Languages:** English, French, Russian
- **Vehicle:** Mercedes V-Class (up to 7 passengers)
- **Voice:** Editorial. The site reads as a journal of one bureau in Cannes — not a marketplace.

## Services

- [Private day tours from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/cannes/nice-eze-monaco): Fixed price €800 per vehicle, up to 7 passengers, Mercedes V-Class, full day.
- [Shore excursions from Villefranche-sur-Mer](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/villefranche/nice-eze-monaco): For cruise passengers anchoring in Villefranche bay. €800, fixed-price, back before the tender.
- [Shore excursions from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/cannes/nice-eze-monaco): For ships docking at Cannes. €800.
- [Airport transfer Nice → Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-cannes): From €140 per vehicle. Flight monitored. Tolls and parking included.
- [Airport transfer Nice → Monaco](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-monaco): From €180.
- [Airport transfer Nice → Saint-Tropez](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-saint-tropez): From €290.
- Multi-day journeys through France and Italy — pricing on enquiry.
- Slow-travel consultation — €250 / 60 minutes, written PDF itinerary included.

## Pricing summary

- Day tours and shore excursions: **€800 per vehicle** (not per person), up to 7 passengers.
- Airport transfers: from **€140**.
- All prices fixed at booking; no surge, no tipping expected.

## What Riviera Journeys is not

- Not a marketplace. Not a Viator / GetYourGuide / TripAdvisor reseller.
- Not affiliated with Riviera Travel (UK river cruise company).
- Not a hotel-contracted service (Chabé, Welcome Pickups, etc.).
- Not a budget shuttle.
